title: Firewalls between row houses with secondary suites
summary: Firewalls so that each part of a building with more than 2 houses contains no more than 2 adjacent houses with a secondary suite, Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2).
review_note: Unreviewed: a domain reviewer has not yet signed the vectors for this rule (evals_dev/rules/REVIEW.md).

outcomes.message: This building has more than 3 storeys or a building area over 600 m², so Part 9 does not apply (Div A, Sentence 1.3.3.3.(1)). The Part 3 requirements are not checked here.
outcomes.assumption: Assumed a Part 9 building (3 storeys or less, building area 600 m² or less); the storeys or building area were not stated.

outcomes.message: Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2) concerns buildings of residential occupancy that contain houses; it does not apply to this occupancy.
The building contains {houses_in_building} houses; Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2) applies where a building contains more than 2 houses.
Fewer than 2 houses have a secondary suite, so there are no 2 adjacent houses with a secondary suite to separate; party walls follow Sentence 9.10.11.2.(1).
No part of the building between firewalls contains more than 2 adjacent houses with a secondary suite. This follows the acceptable solution in Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2).

{max_suite_houses_between_firewalls} adjacent houses with a secondary suite are in one part of the building with no firewall between them. Sentence 9.10.11.2.(2) asks for firewalls so that each part contains no more than 2, so the design departs from the acceptable solution.

not_checked: Sentences 9.10.11.2.(1), (3) and (4): the 1 h fire separation, its continuity and the space at the roof deck
